# isInteger

<link-summary>Checks whether a value is an integer.</link-summary>

<web-summary>isInteger() — Checks whether a value is an integer. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>lang/number</code> · Since: 1.5.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function isInteger(value: unknown): value is number;
```

A number with no fractional part. Nothing is coerced, so the string `"42"` is not an integer, and `NaN` is not either.

`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type      | Description         |
| :-------- | :-------- | :------------------ |
| `value`   | `unknown` | The value to check. |

## Returns

`boolean` — `true` when the value is an integer; otherwise `false`.

In TypeScript the guard narrows `value` to `number` inside the branch.

## Examples

### What passes and what does not

```javascript
isInteger(42); // => true
isInteger(-7); // => true
isInteger(0); // => true
isInteger(1.5); // => false
isInteger(NaN); // => false
isInteger("42"); // => false
```
